title: Intraday Strategy looked promising in backtests but struggled in OOS. How would you tweak?
author: Shishsmurf

comments.author: QATSAlgo
comments.body: QATS team here. Before changing the model, compare it with an equal-weight basket drawn from the same eligible stocks, entered at the same time and exited at 15:55, with the same costs. That separates stock selection from the trading window more cleanly than full-day SPY. Then freeze the model and stress entry delays, spread and rejected/partial fills. If you tune a no-trade filter on 2025, that period becomes research data; keep a later period untouched. Is your universe reconstructed as it existed each day?

replies.author: Shishsmurf
replies.body:
Appreciate this. Yes, the universe is reconstructed historically using prior-session liquidity, and we’ve already checked survivorship and ticker changes.

I’ll try the equal-weight basket comparison with matching entry times, exits and costs, then stress delays, spreads and rejected/partial fills with the model frozen. Agreed on keeping any period used to tune a filter out of the validation claims. I’ll report back with what I find
